headline: Race issues a corrigendum regarding its step-down subsidiary incorporation
summary: Race has submitted a corrigendum to correct an earlier intimation filed on November 25, 2026, regarding the incorporation of a step-down subsidiary. Such procedural corrections are routine administrative updates and do not alter the core business operations or financial standing of the company. For an Indian retail investor, this filing has no material impact on share price or company value.
why_it_matters: No financial impact for retail investors.
